files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Support empty search requests (`SearchRequest::isEmptySearch()` / `empty_search` option): when a request allows an empty search and the search text is blank, return the viewer-accessible documents matching the active filters ordered newest first (`modified_time DESC`); no re-indexing is needed.
- Support `ISearchRequestSimpleQuery` (`getSimpleQueries()`) comparisons (`TEXT`, `KEYWORD`, `ARRAY`, `BOOL`, `INT_EQ`/`GTE`/`GT`/`LTE`/`LT`, `WILDCARD`, `REGEX`) across `info` keys and known document columns, enforcing the search regex/wildcard bounds and matching nothing on unknown, reserved, or type-mismatched fields; no re-indexing is needed.

### Changed
- Batch vocabulary lookups and visibility/stopword probes per search without repeating accent lookups on the spelling pass, and make `VocabularyService::rebuild()` (`occ fulltextsearch_pgsql:vocabulary --rebuild`) serialize with `pg_advisory_xact_lock`, page by `id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT n`, and populate a shadow table swapped in by rename so corrections stay active while rebuilding; no re-indexing is needed.

### Fixed
- Emit `o:__all` instead of `u:__all` when a document is owned by an account literally named `__all` (granting `o:__all` only to that same viewer while keeping `u:__all` public shares intact and skipping empty, NUL, or invalid UTF-8 access principals). Re-indexing is needed only if an account named `__all` already owns indexed documents.
- Preserve the unflattened sub-tags map (`array<string, list<string>>`) in a new `subtags_map` `jsonb` column (`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, instant and without rewriting `tsv`) and rebuild `IndexDocument::setSubTags()` from it in `getDocument()`, falling back to splitting `subtags` at the first underscore for older rows so `getSubTags(false)` and `getSubTags(true)` round-trip cleanly without warnings; no re-indexing is needed unless sub-tag source names themselves contain underscores.
- Normalize dotted `İ` (`U+0130`) to `i` before PHP lowercasing across `TsQueryBuilder`, `VocabularyService`, and `SearchService` so non-Turkish configurations agree with PostgreSQL's `lower()` for accent variants, spelling corrections, and title-substring matching, and build the trigram title-similarity fallback text per configured language; no re-indexing is needed.
- Search transaction, pagination, and query-operator hardening: isolate caller-owned search transactions with a savepoint so handled timeouts or PHP errors never abort the caller's transaction or leak planner GUCs, explicitly set `statement_timeout` to `0` when `search_timeout = 0`, pin `pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold` transaction-locally, clamp large page offsets against integer overflow, skip the trigram title fallback on stopword-only queries, scrub invalid UTF-8 and NUL bytes in tag filters and `PgArray`, preserve `+` and `-` operators past the 32-term cap, and schema-qualify `pg_catalog.simple` / `pg_catalog.regconfig`; no re-indexing is needed.
- Indexing transaction, metadata, and vocabulary hardening: isolate vocabulary updates and language detection in savepoints when indexing inside a caller's transaction, sanitize `parts` keys against NUL bytes and invalid UTF-8 before `jsonb` encoding, escape `regconfig[]` literals with `PgArray` in `LanguageDetector`, and schema-qualify `pg_catalog.simple` while ordering vocabulary inserts by `COLLATE "C"` to match the primary key; no re-indexing is needed.
- Content extraction and `max_content_size` handling: clamp `max_content_size` to `0`–`1,000,000` when read, skip body extraction cleanly when `max_content_size = 0` without spawning extraction tools, emitting false warnings, or wiping document tags and parts, unlink temporary files if writing an office zip fails, and reject NUL-free high-byte binary streams instead of indexing them as Windows-1254 text. Re-index affected documents if `max_content_size = 0` or binary files were previously indexed.
- Packaging, benchmark gate, and CI hygiene: fail `tests/bench/run.php` with non-zero exit codes on missing/invalid `--compare` baselines or `--check-budget` breaches, stage `make appstore` release files from `git archive HEAD` so untracked working-tree files cannot enter App Store archives, and update the lockfile comment in `live.yml`; no re-indexing is needed.
